caption:
OpenAI kills ChatGPT Atlas browser. What's replacing it?

OpenAI is discontinuing ChatGPT Atlas, its standalone desktop browser, in favor of the new ChatGPT desktop app. The company released an update to transition users to the new app.

ChatGPT Atlas was a dedicated browser for interacting with ChatGPT. The new desktop app aims to provide a more integrated experience.

Users will need to switch to the new ChatGPT desktop app. No details on support for existing Atlas users have been provided.
